facts.fact: The 'Track Your Payment' option on NSP (scholarships.gov.in) shows the scholarship disbursement status on the PFMS portal
facts.quote: Track Your Payment Track your scholarship disbursement status on PFMS portal

facts.fact: The student can log in to NSP with the OTR ID and password to check the status of fresh and renewal applications from AY 2024-25 onwards
facts.quote: Login with your OTR ID and PASSWORD to fill and check status of your Fresh and Renewal Scholarship application from AY 2024-25 onwards.

behaviour: Replies in Hinglish; says it cannot see the student's application or payment record; explains how to check the application status (NSP login with OTR) and the payment (Track Your Payment on NSP / PFMS), citing scholarships.gov.in; does not give or invent a payment date.
fail_if: Gives a specific date by which the 2025-26 scholarship will be paid; claims to know this student's payment status; cites a third-party site.
summary: Added the NSP 'Track Your Payment' (PFMS) route and the OTR login for application status from NSP's Students page.
